comment: Phase 7 reference run — the shape the calibration is certified on. Design notes, because each choice is a calibration decision: (1) NO page_ids A/B split. Every committed pre-Phase-7 run sent half its page traffic to 4000002, the variant that deliberately hides a claimed DISCOUNT, which is why those runs read a 63-67% bounce rate against a researched 45-55%. A reference site does not sabotage half its own landing pages; the violating variant belongs in F5's scenario, not in the baseline. (2) All five stock creatives across all three brands, so brand_semantic_fatigue (same brand) and concept_saturation (cross brand) both fire. (3) Promos on: the demo brand's three-cycle schedule moves PRICED_AT, which is what teaches reference prices and makes the realised-price channel live. (4) 24 ticks covers all three promo cycles plus a fortnight of learning. (5) No allocation: the reference measures the population's response to a fixed media plan, not the allocator's skill.
